description: Reopen r-sort-3b-lg (General, LANGID 0x0409) read-only; reads Version and CollatingOrder. Table-type recordsets walk reading ID: T with no Index (storage order), T by IX_K forward and backward, T by IX_KD forward and backward, and the unindexed twin T0. Asks the physical traversal order, tie order and Null and empty placement of an ascending and a descending Text index under this locale.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
